The problem

A client asks for plastic-free hampers. Every option he finds fails him.

Costs more than he can absorb

Kraft tube RM1.90 vs RM0.85 jar. +RM2,100 across one Raya season.

Doesn't protect the product

Kuih bangkit go soft in our humidity. Paper tubes get crushed by couriers.

He can't tell which claim is real

"Biodegradable" jars nobody in Kajang collects. They'd go to landfill anyway.

No expert, no time

A consultant costs more than his margin. Minimum order 5,000. Ramadan is his busiest month.

Result He keeps the plastic and loses the hamper order.

It's not just him

Sellers are stuck between cost, durability and recycling reality.

1.09 million MSMEs · 96.1% of Malaysian businesses (DOSM 2024) EPR packaging rules mandatory by 2030

Why it needs AI

A form or a search engine can't do these four things.

VisionReads his packaging from a photo

Sees a clear jar, a coloured lid, a tray and no resin code, so he doesn't have to know material names.

ReasoningWeighs trade-offs for his product

Balances RM budget, shelf life in our humidity, courier damage and hand-filling, together, for this product.

Unstructured inputTurns uncertainty into labels

Separates what it can see from what it is guessing, so he knows what to ask his supplier.

LanguageSpeaks his language

Understands English, Bahasa Malaysia and Manglish, and answers follow-up questions about his own report.

What breaks first at 100,000 users

  • Bedrock rate limits on Claude Haiku: request a quota increase and queue bursts.
  • Image service quotas: move fully to Nova Canvas in us-east-1.
  • 30-second API limit: switch long sections to true streaming.

Who gets left out, and our plan

  • Low digital literacy: BM by default, photo-first flow, brief sent by WhatsApp.
  • No smartphone or data: run sessions through SME agencies and co-ops.
  • Not a certification: EcoLens tells users what to verify with suppliers.
Pilot and next three weeks

Pilot with SME Corp Malaysia's food entrepreneurs before Raya 2027.

The pilot

  • 50 home-based food sellers, February 2027, ahead of the Raya rush
  • Measure: switches made, cost per pack, supplier briefs sent
  • Success: 1 in 3 sellers changes at least one packaging part

If we had 3 more weeks

  • Photo-only flow: no form, one best-fit answer first (already built on a branch)
  • Stronger images: Nova Canvas for every redesign visual
  • Local supplier directory so the brief goes to a real Malaysian supplier
